title: Health-sector job flow does not identify county care need or routine-care outcomes
source_unit: US county; 2023 BDS health-sector net-job flow joined to CDC PLACES 2025 modeled county measures
geography: United States; 2,878 counties with a reported BDS health net-job rate and at least one selected PLACES measure

observations.period: 2023 BDS health-sector flow; negative net-job-rate counties; PLACES 2025 release

denominator.unit: counties with negative reported BDS health-sector net-job rate

lack_health_insurance.unit: median PLACES percent of adults aged 18-64

observations.method: Same-year county ecological comparison of BDS health-sector net-job sign and PLACES modeled estimates; unweighted medians by available measure denominator.
observations.uncertainty: PLACES estimates are modeled; measure universes differ, and county employer flow is not provider availability or resident use.
observations.subgroup: Counties with negative reported BDS health-sector net-job rate.
observations.counterinterpretation: Negative employer flow does not uniformly correspond to higher modeled burden; the comparison does not estimate an effect.

observations.period: 2023 BDS health-sector flow; nonnegative net-job-rate counties; PLACES 2025 release

denominator.unit: counties with nonnegative reported BDS health-sector net-job rate

lack_health_insurance.unit: median PLACES percent of adults aged 18-64

observations.method: Same-year county ecological comparison of BDS health-sector net-job sign and PLACES modeled estimates; unweighted medians by available measure denominator.
observations.uncertainty: PLACES estimates are modeled; measure universes differ, and county employer flow is not provider availability or resident use.
observations.subgroup: Counties with nonnegative reported BDS health-sector net-job rate.
observations.counterinterpretation: Routine-checkup and transportation-insecurity medians are identical to the negative-flow group, weakening a simple employer-flow-to-care-outcome reading.

observations.period: 2023 BDS health-sector flow; full selected join

denominator.unit: counties with health-sector flow and at least one selected PLACES measure

routine_checkup_median_difference.unit: percentage points, negative-flow minus nonnegative-flow groups

transportation_insecurity_median_differe.unit: percentage points, negative-flow minus nonnegative-flow groups

observations.method: County FIPS join and group-median comparison using the retained compact PLACES release and transient BDS suffix.
observations.uncertainty: This is not a resident panel, provider-availability measure, or causal estimate; raw BDS is not retained.
observations.subgroup: All matched counties in the bounded join.
observations.counterinterpretation: A near-null ecological contrast does not show no effect; it shows that employer flow alone cannot identify the care-use and household mechanism.

related_sources.claim: CDC PLACES provides modeled small-area health-related estimates.

boundary: This is a same-year county ecological comparison between employer flows and modeled PLACES estimates. It does not identify providers or residents, establish causation, or measure appointment availability, use, delay, recovery, trust, or action.
